annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei n. 477/2024 - Tipifica na lei penal a alteração de fotos, vídeos e som com o uso de sistema de Inteligência Artificial para praticar violência contra a mulher
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 477/2024 - Criminalizing the alteration of photos, videos and sound using Artificial Intelligence systems to commit violence against women
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados (Dep. Saullo Vianna, União/AM)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill PL 477/2024 amends the Penal Code to add Article 216-C, criminalising altering, manipulating or falsifying photos, videos or sounds using AI or other means to humiliate, harass or threaten women in domestic or family settings, with two to four years' imprisonment plus a fine.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds Art. 216-C to the Penal Code (Decreto-Lei 2.848/1940)
Criminalises AI-based manipulation of photos, videos or audio to cause humiliation, harassment, threat or violence against women
Applies in domestic or family contexts
Penalty: two to four years' imprisonment and a fine
Justification: AI-enabled gender violence and non-consensual content
